forces.title: Emergence of streaming video as a high-growth 'arena'
forces.description: Streaming video is identified as a "future arena" exhibiting characteristics of exceptional growth, competitive dynamism, and the ability to attract new entrants. This structural shift implies faster evolution and potential for value concentration compared to traditional industries, requiring strategic adaptation from established players. Companies in this sector need to shift from defending existing positions to actively competing within or around these new dynamics.
forces.source_title: Strategy in the age of arenas

forces.title: Streaming platforms shifting media profit pools via customer relationships
forces.description: Streaming platforms are identified as an "adjacent arena" that has already demonstrated the ability to gradually shift industry profit pools within the broader media landscape. This is primarily achieved by taking direct control of customer relationships, thereby altering the fundamental mechanisms of value creation and capture. This necessitates a re-evaluation of business models for other media entities, as traditional players lose direct customer access.

viewpoints.title: Streaming video positioned as a high-growth arena for future profit expansion
viewpoints.description: McKinsey identifies "Streaming video" as one of 18 potential future arenas, projecting it to exhibit exceptional growth and competitive dynamism over the next 15 years. These arenas are characterized by fast evolution, new entrants, value concentration, and the ability to cut across traditional industry boundaries, reshaping value chains. This indicates a strong positive outlook for the sector's long-term growth potential and its significance in the broader economy, demanding that leaders adapt strategies from defending legacy positions to competing within these new arenas.
viewpoints.source_title: Strategy in the age of arenas

demand_drivers.description: Consumers are increasingly shifting towards streaming video, driving demand for platforms that offer diverse and engaging content tailored to individual preferences.
The ability of streaming platforms to offer tailored content and user experiences fosters higher engagement and subscription retention, acting as a key demand driver.

new_opportunities.description: Streaming video, as an 'arena,' is expected to reshape existing media value chains and create new profit pools by altering content creation, distribution, and monetization models.

market_sizing.methodology: McKinsey identifies "Streaming video" as a "potential future arena" among 18 others, expected to display "exceptional growth and competitive dynamism" over the next 15 years. This classification is based on the characteristics of 'arenas' identified between 2005 and 2020, which accounted for approximately 85% of global profit growth. The analysis suggests that these arenas evolve faster, attract more new entrants, and can concentrate value, indicating significant future market development and strategic importance for streaming video.
